title: musubi.json
description: The musubi declaration next to a skill's SKILL.md: the content the skill provides and the content it follows.

musubi.description: The date of the musubi definition this file follows.

provides.description: Content this skill provides, by name.

version.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. Raise MAJOR when a following skill can break.

file.description: The content file, relative to the skill folder.

check.description: A JSON rules file, relative to the skill folder, that musubi check applies to the examples of following skills.

version.description: The versions this skill accepts: ^X.Y.Z, ~X.Y.Z, or X.Y.Z.

integrity.description: The fingerprint of the content at the last check.

examples.description: Files of this skill that the provider's check is applied to.
